---
title: "Examples"
---

Each script runs with `uv run python examples/<name>.py` from the
repository root.

| Script | What it prints |
| --- | --- |
| `examples/run_paper.py` | The paper in Kiku's order: Table I, the log-linear solution, cash-flow moments, the grid, Table VII. |
| `examples/table_ii_calibration.py` | The Table II parameters, read from `ModelParams()` at run time. |
| `examples/two_firms.py` | Two synthetic firms that differ only in $\phi$. |
| `examples/calibrate_any_portfolio.py` | Measure loadings from cash-flows you supply, then price the cross-section. |
| `examples/dcf_counterfactual.py` | The same cash-flows priced by a DCF and by the equilibrium solver. |
| `examples/robustness.py` | The premium as one parameter at a time is varied. |

The shortest path on Table II is the home-page example.

```python
import lrrcs as lrr

model = lrr.LongRunRisksModel()
res = model.solve()
print(res.summary())
print(res.compare("value", "growth", market="market").summary())
```
